implementation.denominator: Distance between the two goal lines of the rendered pitch in the same coordinate system as the player markers. Exclude panel borders, padding, toolbar and any overflow of the role cards.
implementation.measurement: Measure the longitudinal difference between matching anchors on the subject and reference role cards, then divide by the goal-line-to-goal-line pitch height and multiply by 100.
implementation.sign_convention: Positive is toward the opponent goal, negative is toward the own goal, zero leaves the base position unchanged.
implementation.application: Displacement along the attack direction = pitch height * vertical_shift_percent / 100. For a screen y-axis increasing downward and the opponent goal at the top, subtract that displacement from the base y.
implementation.base_position: Use the unshifted slot row. For WB (L/R), use the central DM row at the wide slot x. For AM (L/R), use the central AM row at the wide slot x. Apply the stored value once, including for WB-IP and W-IP.
implementation.symmetry: A profile covering a mirrored pair uses the same vertical value on both sides. The shift never changes the slot x coordinate.
implementation.estimates: Percent values are rounded screenshot estimates or zero-line assignments. The observations retain the original evidence and pixel estimates.

profiles.default_basis: Use the smaller observed shift as the default because the exact trigger for the larger shift is unverified.
